scope: Implementation and transport correctness only; GPU performance qualification is performed separately by the parent agent.
change: Batch host sequence-state transfers for ordinary non-host CUDA buffers, synchronize each used backend at completion or before a synchronous fallback, and preserve serialized byte layout.

checks: deferred CUDA-like reads and writes complete before returning
one fence per used CUDA backend for a homogeneous batch
view offsets and metadata gaps match synchronous bytes
host/special alias fallback cannot overtake pending CUDA writes
CPU, Metal, split and unmatched buffers use synchronous accessors
opt-out, empty transfers and null schedulers retain fallback behavior
actual tiny CPU model snapshots are byte-identical across modes
post-restore CPU logits match across modes
truncated restore rejects malformed data and subsequent valid restore recovers
managed_patch_stack: reverse removal leaves pristine tracked files and no new header
custom revision skips patches and removes stale metadata

limits: No GPU performance or model-quality claim from these CPU/fake-backend checks.
CPU, HIP, Metal, split and special buffer paths retain synchronous transfers.
No production worker or image was replaced by this agent.
